title: Great Book Human Map / Nexus of Being — Recovered Mathematics Audit
status: old-document archaeology + mathematical repair + multivariate consciousness research design; not an empirical theory of enlightenment
abstract: The Human Map / Nexus of Being material is best treated as an early multivariate consciousness framework rather than as a collection of literal biological formulas. The recovered Great Book equations combine neural oscillations, neuromodulators, cerebrospinal-fluid rhythms, graph metrics, predictive coding, fractal measures, social synchrony and phenomenological labels, but several historical expressions add incompatible units or attach unsupported numerical values to states such as 'enlightenment'. The rigorous research version therefore replaces fixed mystical constants with a hierarchical measurement-and-state model: latent cognitive/phenomenological states generate multimodal observations such as EEG/MEG features, behavior, autonomic measures and self-report, while subject, session and context effects are modeled explicitly. Transitions, dwell times, metastability, integration/segregation and behavioral outcomes can then be estimated and compared across preregistered conditions. The project-specific contribution is the attempt to organize Body, Mind and Spirit-era variables into one typed multiscale state description; its scientific value depends on whether this organization improves prediction or discriminates conditions beyond simpler neuroscience models. The framework is currently T1-T2: methodologically repairable and experimentally specifiable, but not a validated biomarker or theory of enlightenment.
source_note: Recovered from The Great Book Of Potato2.odt, especially parsed pages 504-509 and 533-540. The source mixed established mathematics, project-created formulas, phenomenology and unsupported numerical neuroscience claims.
epistemic_rule: Preserve the historical equations, but never promote mixed-unit or unsupported formulas into physical law. Each recovered form is typed as established comparator, project schematic, or quarantined formula.
research_question: Can a typed multivariate state-space model of neural, physiological, behavioral and phenomenological measurements identify reproducible state/trait structure more accurately than simple single-metric accounts, without presupposing a privileged 'enlightenment frequency' or one-dimensional score?
maturity: T1 conceptual framework with T2 candidate mathematical models; no validated composite biomarker

measurement_architecture.latent_state: z_t represents an unobserved cognitive/phenomenological state or state vector; its interpretation must be learned/tested rather than named in advance from one signal.
measurement_architecture.observation_vector: y_t=(EEG/MEG features, connectivity, complexity, autonomic measures, behavior, task performance, self-report, contextual covariates)
measurement_architecture.transition_model: p(z_t|z_(t-1),condition,subject) or a continuous state-space/SDE analogue
measurement_architecture.hierarchy: population -> subject -> session -> epoch/trial, with random effects or hierarchical priors when data support them
measurement_architecture.rule: The latent state is not automatically 'Spirit' or 'enlightenment'; labels are interpretations that require convergent behavioral/phenomenological evidence.

candidate_hidden_state_model.dwell_time: For non-geometric dwell distributions use a hidden semi-Markov model rather than forcing a basic HMM.
candidate_hidden_state_model.entropy_rate: h=-sum_i pi_i sum_j A_ij log A_ij for a stationary Markov model
candidate_hidden_state_model.research_value: This turns 'states of consciousness' into estimable transition/dwell structures rather than static mystical categories.

recovered_equations.name: Thalamic oscillation equation
recovered_equations.audit: As written, coefficients and inputs mix concentrations, flow/frequency and membrane voltage without a dimensional model. It is not a valid biophysical membrane equation.
recovered_equations.repair: Use C_m dV/dt=-sum_k g_k(V-E_k)+I_ext for a conductance-style model, or use a neural-mass model. Neuromodulators should change defined parameters/gains with units rather than be directly added to voltage.
recovered_equations.observable_link: Membrane/neural-mass parameters must map to electrophysiological measurements or remain illustrative.

recovered_equations.name: Claustrum synchrony
recovered_equations.historical_form: S_claustrum(t)=sum_i w_i sin(2 pi f_gamma t) exp(-k D_state) cos(phi_cortex)
recovered_equations.audit: Evaluable only if state distance, k, phases and weights are explicitly normalized; historical interpretation as an enlightenment predictor was unsupported.
recovered_equations.repair: Use phase-locking value, coherence, weighted phase synchrony or Kuramoto order parameter R(t)=|N^-1 sum_j exp(i theta_j)|, with source-leakage/common-input controls.
recovered_equations.baseline: Compare against ordinary regional synchrony/connectivity models; claustral specificity requires anatomical/source-localized evidence.

recovered_equations.name: CSF oscillator
recovered_equations.historical_form: F_CSF(t)=A sin(2 pi f_CSF t) exp(-k[amyloid])
recovered_equations.audit: Phenomenological oscillator, not a derived glymphatic or hydrodynamic equation. Exponential attenuation requires k[amyloid] dimensionless and a defined concentration variable.
recovered_equations.repair: Fit measured CSF waveform components from appropriate physiology/MRI if this branch is studied; treat consciousness interpretation as a separate hypothesis.
recovered_equations.failure_condition: If CSF dynamics add no predictive value after cardiorespiratory and motion effects are modeled, do not retain them as a consciousness-specific feature.

recovered_equations.name: Predictive-coding score
recovered_equations.audit: This is not Bayes' theorem; oscillatory phase factors were appended without a probabilistic derivation.
recovered_equations.repair: Use p(h|y) proportional to p(y|h)p(h), or construct an explicit generative model in which neural phases modulate a defined precision/gain parameter.
recovered_equations.test: Compare held-out predictive likelihood with and without the phase-dependent precision term.

recovered_equations.name: Variational free-energy expression
recovered_equations.origin_class: established-math-neighbor reconstructed from malformed source notation
recovered_equations.audit: The rigorous variational identity is F[q]=E_q[log q(s)-log p(y,s)]=KL(q(s)||p(s|y))-log p(y).
recovered_equations.repair: Keep as an external inference framework. A biological/free-energy-principle interpretation requires a specific generative model and empirical comparison.

recovered_equations.name: Cultural-prior weighting
recovered_equations.audit: Useful schematic for context weighting if terms are defined; not a validated cultural-neuroscience law.
recovered_equations.repair: Use hierarchical Bayesian or mixed-effects models with culture/context as measured predictors; predefine the comparison and avoid treating group labels as biological essences.

recovered_equations.name: Transcendent / emotional cascade
recovered_equations.historical_form: T_cascade(t)=sum_i w_i sin(2 pi f_i t) exp(R_i D_state) cos(phi_i) cos(theta_i)
recovered_equations.audit: The source mixed oscillatory phases, affect/fractal labels and biochemical variables without a measurement model.
recovered_equations.repair: Split neural oscillatory features, physiology, affect and biochemical covariates into typed channels and estimate their joint relation using a state-space, GLM/GAM or hierarchical model.

recovered_equations.name: Self-actualization score
recovered_equations.audit: Invalid as a physical equation because concentration, spectral power and psychological score are added directly.
recovered_equations.repair: If a composite is needed, standardize features within a declared population, preregister weights or estimate them using training data, and evaluate the score on held-out outcomes. Call it an exploratory composite rather than self-actualization itself.
recovered_equations.failure_condition: Discard or revise the composite if it lacks reliability, measurement invariance or out-of-sample predictive value.

recovered_equations.name: Collective-unity oscillator
recovered_equations.historical_form: U_collective=sum_i w_i cos(phi_vagus,i) sin(2 pi f_theta,i t) exp(k D_ritual,i)
recovered_equations.audit: No validated physiological interpretation as written.
recovered_equations.repair: For group experiments use hyperscanning measures plus behavioral coordination and null/permutation controls for common sensory drive, movement and task timing.
recovered_equations.causal_warning: Inter-brain correlation does not demonstrate direct brain-to-brain causal coupling or quantum nonlocality.

recovered_equations.name: EEG coherence aggregate
recovered_equations.audit: Covariance depends on amplitude scale/reference; historical fractal-state modifier was unsupported.
recovered_equations.repair: Prefer normalized coherence, imaginary coherence, phase-lag metrics or source-space graph measures with artifact/source-leakage controls.

recovered_equations.name: Network score
recovered_equations.audit: Degree, betweenness and clustering are legitimate graph quantities, but direct multiplication creates scale dependence and unclear interpretation.
recovered_equations.repair: Keep metrics separate or combine only after normalization and predictive validation; compare with graph null models that preserve relevant degree/weight structure.

recovered_equations.name: Box-counting fractal dimension
recovered_equations.audit: Legitimate mathematical definition. Historical assignments D=4.5 'Enlightenment' and D=3.0 'NPD' are quarantined and must not be repeated as established findings.
recovered_equations.rigor_note: Finite biological signals require estimator choice, scaling range, uncertainty and surrogate-data comparison; an estimated exponent is not an identity label.

recovered_equations.name: Neural avalanche power law
recovered_equations.audit: A legitimate criticality-style distribution family. Evidence requires likelihood-based model comparison, finite-size analysis and alternatives rather than visual log-log straightness.

recovered_equations.name: Consciousness Spiral
recovered_equations.audit: Mathematically valid logarithmic spiral with exact quarter-turn scaling r(theta+pi/2)=phi r(theta). Physical/neural interpretation remains project-specific.
recovered_equations.test: If fitted to empirical trajectories, estimate a,b and residuals, compare against Archimedean/power-law/spline alternatives and test the fixed golden-ratio b against a freely estimated b.

recovered_equations.name: Human Map composite
recovered_equations.audit: Historically important but underdefined. It is a function signature, not yet a model.
recovered_equations.repair: Define a typed feature vector and a target variable first; choose a transparent model class, fit on training data and evaluate on held-out subjects/sessions.

consciousness_research_upgrade.principle: Replace fixed mystical numbers with state estimation, measurement reliability and falsifiable comparisons.
candidate_observables: behavioral report reliability and task performance
autonomic variables such as HRV when relevant
fMRI network connectivity with preregistered preprocessing
consciousness_research_upgrade.state_trait_separation: State effects are within-person/session changes; trait effects are persistent between-person differences. Analyze them separately before claiming a stable spiritual/psychological type.
consciousness_research_upgrade.enlightenment_rule: Operationalize a specific outcome such as sustained nondual report, attentional stability, compassion behavior, meditation expertise or another defined construct; never encode 'enlightenment' as a biological constant.
consciousness_research_upgrade.exploratory_index: E*=w^T z(q_conscious) may be used only as a preregistered dimensionless research score with held-out validation; it is not enlightenment itself.

minimal_experimental_program.design: Repeated-measures longitudinal or within-subject intervention design is preferred for state changes; include matched/control conditions when causal language is used.
minimal_experimental_program.preprocessing: Freeze artifact rejection, referencing/source reconstruction, frequency bands and quality thresholds before outcome analysis where feasible.
minimal_experimental_program.primary_outcome: Choose one primary behavioral/phenomenological outcome and one primary neural model comparison rather than dozens of post hoc correlations.
minimal_experimental_program.model_comparison: Compare the multivariate latent-state model against simpler baselines such as spectral power alone, questionnaire alone and stationary connectivity.
minimal_experimental_program.validation: Use held-out sessions/subjects, posterior predictive checks or cross-validation as appropriate.
minimal_experimental_program.nulls: Permutation/surrogate tests should preserve temporal/autocorrelation structure relevant to the statistic.
minimal_experimental_program.replication: Any promoted biomarker should reproduce across an independent dataset and reasonable preprocessing alternatives.

major_confounders_and_failure_modes: motion, muscle and eye artifacts can mimic high-frequency EEG effects
volume conduction/source leakage can inflate connectivity/coherence
respiration and cardiac rhythms can drive apparent neural/CSF coupling
multiple comparisons and flexible preprocessing can create false positives
self-report labels may be unstable, demand-characteristic or culturally conditioned
group-level separation may fail to classify individuals and vice versa
a complex latent model is not valuable if it fails to outperform a simpler baseline out of sample
completion_path: Freeze the archaeology: retain historical equations exactly and separately from repaired models.
Fit a latent-state or other explicit statistical model.
Compare with simple baselines on held-out data.
Replicate before promoting any variable to a canonical Human Map biomarker.
